entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Hive-minded creatures that share abilities with nearby slivers, originating on an unknown plane and spread through the Multiverse.

entities.name: Sliver Queen
entities.description: The queen of Rath's sliver hive, brought to Rath by Volrath and later convinced by Karn to release the Legacy.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A shapeshifter and obsessive zoologist who brought the Sliver Queen to Rath and studied and perhaps modified slivers.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member who persuaded the Sliver Queen to release the Legacy.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member who realized how the slivers' hive mind worked.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: The captain of the Weatherlight whom Volrath and his hive opposed.

entities.name: Sliver Overlord
entities.description: The ultimate manifestation of the hive mind, fused from the surviving slivers.

entities.name: Gravemother
entities.description: A sliver queen on an unknown plane who conquered death and razed the plane.

entities.name: Weaver King
entities.description: A being who took control of the slivers to wage war on Freyalise and Windgrace.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who maintained some control over slivers in her realm.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: A planeswalker who maintained some control over slivers in his realm.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: The being created by the magical explosion at Sanctum that killed most slivers.

entities.name: Hivestone
entities.description: An artifact in the Stronghold ruins used by evincars to control the sliver hive, which becomes a curse to its wielder.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane to which Volrath brought the Sliver Queen.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The event during which the slivers were transported to Urborg.

entities.name: Riptide Project
entities.description: Wizards on Otaria who revived slivers without recreating their queen.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The place to which slivers were transported in the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The plane where the Riptide Project revived slivers.

events.summary: Volrath takes a number of the Sliver Queen's brood away to study them in the Furnace of Rath.
events.quote: He then took a number of her brood away from her (and stuck them in the Furnace of Rath ) so he could study them.

events.summary: Volrath uses the hive to guard the Legacy and attack the Weatherlight crew.
events.quote: Volrath used the hive to guard the Legacy and to attack Weatherlight and her crew on their quest to retake those artifacts and their captain, Sisay .

events.summary: Karn convinces the Sliver Queen to release the Legacy after Hanna realizes how the hive mind works.
events.quote: Karn was able to convince the Sliver Queen to release the Legacy to him

events.summary: During the Rathi Overlay slivers are transported to Urborg, most dying and the rest killed in the Invasion.
events.quote: During the Rathi Overlay the slivers were transported to Urborg .

events.summary: Riptide Project wizards revive slivers without recreating the Sliver Queen, and the slivers go rampant.
events.quote: Without her, the slivers went rampant, proving impossible to tame and breeding out of control.

events.summary: Most slivers die in the explosion that created Karona; a small group fuses into the Sliver Overlord.
events.quote: However, a small group of slivers survived and fused into the ultimate manifestation of the hive mind, the Sliver Overlord .

events.summary: The Weaver King takes control of slivers to wage war on their former masters.
events.quote: Once the Weaver King discovered the simplicity of their hivemind, he quickly took control of them for his purposes and used them to wage war on their former masters.

events.summary: On an unknown plane the Gravemother's brood razes kingdoms in a single night.
events.quote: In a single night, kingdoms were reduced to rubble as their former servants were joined by the Gravemother's hardened brood.

relations.note: Volrath brought the Sliver Queen to Rath.
relations.quote: he was so fascinated by these mesomorphic, hive-minded creatures that he brought the Sliver Queen to Rath .

relations.note: He used slivers against their former masters.
relations.quote: Once the Weaver King discovered the simplicity of their hivemind, he quickly took control of them for his purposes and used them to wage war on their former masters.

relations.note: A sliver queen who completed their ultimate evolution.
relations.quote: this queen, the Gravemother , finally completed the ultimate evolution: to conquer death.

relations.note: Hanna's insight let the crew defeat the slivers and Karn convince the Queen.
relations.quote: Thanks to Hanna , who realized how the slivers' hive mind worked, the crew defeated them in the Furnace of Rath
